name: jarvis-desktop
description: Cygnus: tray icon, Ctrl+Alt+J and one window for the HUD. The backend stays in the repo.

scripts.unpack-electron: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Expand-Archive -Force -LiteralPath $env:LOCALAPPDATA\electron\Cache\electron-v33.4.11-win32-x64.zip -DestinationPath node_modules\electron\dist; Set-Content -NoNewline -Encoding ascii node_modules\electron\path.txt electron.exe"
